name: talxis-preview
_comment: PREVIEW CHANNEL, deliberately NOT named 'talxis'. `claude plugin marketplace add` keys on this name, so reusing 'talxis' would silently replace the upstream marketplace (github.com/TALXIS/skills) with this fork, and nobody would be told. This marketplace serves the fork's `preview` branch: the upstream plugins plus the fork's own, ahead of or instead of an upstream release. The rename lives only on `preview`, never on a PR branch, or the PR would read as renaming the maintainers' own marketplace. Plugin names are shared with upstream, so when a plugin ships there, uninstall it from @talxis-preview before installing it from @talxis.

metadata.description: PREVIEW channel of TALXIS/skills, published from a fork so changes can be installed before they merge upstream - use the real `talxis` marketplace for anything already shipped there. TALXIS plugins for coding agents — build Power Platform apps in a local-first monorepo with the TALXIS CLI (txc): scaffold, build, validate, and deploy deterministically.

plugins.name: implement
plugins.description: Build TALXIS / Power Platform apps in a local-first monorepo: scaffold components with the TALXIS CLI (txc), validate with dotnet build, deploy as Package Deployer packages. Use when creating a new TALXIS project or working on an existing one.

plugins.name: consulting
plugins.description: Business analysis and process modeling with UBML - register discovery sources and extract traceable insights from them, walk those insights with a stakeholder until each is confirmed, promote the confirmed ones into the operational model, and validate before every commit. Thin skills that steer the agent to the ubml CLI for everything it covers. Runs ubml 1.4.2-preview.1 from this fork's release. Use when turning interviews, transcripts or discovery notes into a structured business model.
